tools.name: 15five_check_connection
tools.description: Check that the 15Five API token works and report the API response. Use it first when other calls fail with an auth error. GET /api/public/hello/.

tools.name: 15five_list_users
tools.description: List 15Five users (people) with their name, email, employee id, location, active status and admin flags. Filter by email, employee_id, name, or is_active. GET /api/public/user/.

tools.name: 15five_get_user
tools.description: Get one 15Five user by id: contact details, title, reporting flags and last login. GET /api/public/user/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_departments
tools.description: List company departments, optionally filtered by name. GET /api/public/department/.

tools.name: 15five_list_groups
tools.description: List 15Five groups, optionally filtered by name. GET /api/public/group/.

tools.name: 15five_list_objectives
tools.description: List objectives (goals). Objectives are returned regardless of privacy settings. GET /api/public/objective/.

tools.name: 15five_get_objective
tools.description: Get one objective (goal) by id, with its key results and progress. GET /api/public/objective/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_checkins
tools.description: List check-ins (weekly reports). Filter by user and due date. GET /api/public/report/.

tools.name: 15five_get_checkin
tools.description: Get one check-in (report) by id. GET /api/public/report/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_pulse
tools.description: List Check-in Pulse scores. Engagement survey results are not in this API (use the CSV export in the 15Five app). GET /api/public/pulse/.

tools.name: 15five_list_high_fives
tools.description: List high fives (peer recognition messages). Filter by receiver or source check-in. GET /api/public/high-five/.

tools.name: 15five_list_priorities
tools.description: List weekly priorities that people set in their check-ins. Filter by user, manager or group. GET /api/public/priority/.

tools.name: 15five_list_one_on_ones
tools.description: List 1-on-1 meetings between a manager and a report, with their scheduled and ended dates. GET /api/public/one-on-one/.

tools.name: 15five_list_vacations
tools.description: List vacation and time-off records for users. GET /api/public/vacation/.

tools.name: 15five_list_review_cycles
tools.description: List performance review cycles. The API key creator needs company admin, review admin and cycle administrator access, or the list is empty. GET /api/public/review-cycle/.

tools.name: 15five_get_review_cycle
tools.description: Get one review cycle by id. Needs the review permissions described in 15five_list_review_cycles. GET /api/public/review-cycle/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_cycle_participants
tools.description: List who takes part in one review cycle, with their manager and group. GET /api/public/review-cycle/{cycle_id}/participants/.

tools.name: 15five_list_cycle_reviews
tools.description: List the reviews in one review cycle, with their answers and completion state. Needs the review permissions described in 15five_list_review_cycles. GET /api/public/review-cycle/{cycle_id}/reviews/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: 15five_list_users, 15five_list_high_fives, 15five_list_review_cycles, 15five_get_review_cycle, 15five_list_cycle_participants, 15five_list_cycle_reviews · Private data: 15five_check_connection, 15five_get_user, 15five_list_vacations, 15five_list_review_cycles · Public sink: 15five_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: 15five_list_users, 15five_list_high_fives, 15five_list_review_cycles, 15five_get_review_cycle, 15five_list_cycle_participants, 15five_list_cycle_reviews · Private data: 15five_check_connection, 15five_get_user, 15five_list_vacations, 15five_list_review_cycles · Public sink: 15five_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
